# COS Minimal — Modern Scandinavian Fashion & Architectural Tailoring

> Timeless wardrobe essentials conceived for everyday living. Inspired by Scandinavian architectural minimalism, tactile natural textiles, and calm monochrome palettes.

## Store Information
- **Domain:** https://demo-product-shopping-cart.vercel.app
- **Brand:** COS Minimal
- **Core Aesthetic:** Minimalist, Editorial, Scandinavian Contemporary
- **Target Audience:** Modern design-conscious individuals seeking durable, timeless wardrobe pieces over fast fashion.

## Main Collections & Routes
- **Homepage:** https://demo-product-shopping-cart.vercel.app/
- **Shop All Garments:** https://demo-product-shopping-cart.vercel.app/shop

- **Tailored Trousers:** https://demo-product-shopping-cart.vercel.app/shop?category=cat-trousers
- **Outerwear & Coats:** https://demo-product-shopping-cart.vercel.app/shop?category=cat-outerwear

- **Accessories:** https://demo-product-shopping-cart.vercel.app/shop?category=cat-accessories

## Signature Garments
- Oversized Poplin Shirt (Pure organic cotton poplin, stepped hem, concealed placket)
- Wide-Leg Tailored Wool Trousers (RWS-certified wool twill, fluid drape, pressed creases)
- Double-Faced Wool Cocoon Coat (Unlined double-face wool, curved silhouette)
- Asymmetric Draped Midi Dress (Sculptural gather, fluid matte jersey)
- Minimalist Cashmere Crewneck Knit (Grade-A recycled cashmere, ribbed trims)
- Sculptural Leather Crossbody Bag (Supple Italian nappa leather, magnetic clasp)

## Quality & Sustainability Commitment
- RWS (Responsible Wool Standard) certified virgin and recycled wools.
- GOTS-certified 100% organic cotton shirting.
- Plastic-free packaging and transparent ethical fabrication.
- Complimentary standard shipping on orders over $150.
